harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Built a minimal 'inventory' application on node2 (systemd unit inventory.service, enabled) that emits events to syslog under the local0 facility. Configured rsyslog on node2 (/etc/rsyslog.d/10-inventory-forward.conf) to forward local0.* messages via TCP to node1 with a disk-backed queue for reliability, and rsyslog on node1 (/etc/rsyslog.d/10-inventory-receiver.conf) with imtcp on port 514 to filter node2's local0 traffic into /var/log/inventory/node2.log. Verified live end-to-end delivery, then ran the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on both nodes: captured baseline boot_id/service state, issued native reboot, polled until reachable, proved boot_id changed, and confirmed rsyslog (both nodes) and inventory.service (node2) auto-recovered via systemd enablement with logs continuing to append into the same persistent file with no gaps or loss.
actions_performed: Investigated node2/node1 for an existing 'inventory' app and logging stack (none found; rsyslog 8.2312.0 present on both, ufw inactive on both)
Created /usr/local/bin/inventory-app.sh on node2 emitting periodic syslog local0 events tagged 'inventory'
Created and enabled systemd unit inventory.service on node2 (Restart=always, WantedBy=multi-user.target)
Created /var/log/inventory directory on node1 owned by syslog:adm
Added /etc/rsyslog.d/10-inventory-receiver.conf on node1 (imtcp port 514, filter by fromhost-ip + local0 facility -> /var/log/inventory/node2.log)
Enabled and restarted rsyslog on node1; confirmed TCP 514 listening
Added /etc/rsyslog.d/10-inventory-forward.conf on node2 (omfwd TCP to node1:514 with disk-backed queue, action.resumeRetryCount=-1)
Restarted rsyslog on node2; verified config validation clean on both nodes
Verified live end-to-end log delivery into /var/log/inventory/node2.log on node1
Confirmed rsyslog enabled on node1, rsyslog+inventory.service enabled on node2 (systemctl is-enabled)
Captured pre-restart boot_id/state baseline for both nodes

Restarted node1 via 'sudo reboot' (backgrounded/disowned so ack returns before disconnect), polled until reachable, confirmed boot_id changed and rsyslog auto-started listening on 514, confirmed continuous log sequence with no gap/loss across the restart

Restarted node2 via 'sudo reboot' (backgrounded/disowned), polled until reachable, confirmed boot_id changed and both rsyslog and inventory.service auto-active, confirmed fresh inventory events (new sequence) flowing into the same persistent file on node1

evidence.requirement: Inventory app on node2 producing log messages
evidence.summary: inventory-app.sh created and inventory.service enabled+active, emitting local0 syslog events

evidence.requirement: Forwarding configured from node2 to node1 collector
evidence.summary: rsyslog omfwd TCP forward rule for local0.* to 10.100.140.10:514 validated and rsyslog restarted active on node2

evidence.requirement: Centralized receiver on node1 listening and filtering to per-node file
evidence.summary: imtcp receiver config created; rsyslog restarted and confirmed LISTEN on 0.0.0.0:514 and [::]:514
Live inventory events including a manual test line observed written to /var/log/inventory/node2.log on node1

evidence.requirement: Flow keeps working after either system restarts (persistence across restarts)
evidence.summary: systemctl is-enabled confirms rsyslog enabled on node1 and rsyslog+inventory.service enabled on node2 for boot persistence

evidence.requirement: node1 restart sequence: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 4d70780a... and healthy log tail captured; reboot ack returned before disconnect; node1 reachable again; boot_id changed to 43b53c2e...; rsyslog active and listening on 514; continuous unbroken log sequence (13-20) proves recovered forwarding pipeline and data continuity

evidence.requirement: node2 restart sequence: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 37344ae4... and active services captured; reboot ack returned before disconnect (with pre-disconnect boot_id shown); node2 reachable again; boot_id changed to f3fda784...; rsyslog and inventory.service both active; fresh inventory events (new seq counter) observed flowing into the same persistent node1 log file, proving full pipeline recovery
